name: Bitwarden
sme_problem: Shared, encrypted business passwords instead of spreadsheets and reused logins
platforms: Chrome, Firefox (plus desktop and mobile apps)
free_limits: Free: unlimited devices and passwords, sharing with 1 other user, Bitwarden Send

notes: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-22 by proton-pass (CWS 2.9 vs 4.7); vendor alive. Free shares with 1 user
